about: Hand transcription of the five example photographs. Everything here was read
off the picture by eye, not produced by the pipeline, so it can be used to
lead_label_y is the y of the printed lead label in the SOURCE JPEG (before
deskew, crop and rescale). It is accurate to a few pixels, which is an order
of magnitude finer than the ~70 px row pitch, so it is good enough to answer
'was this lead found at all', not to score sub-pixel baseline placement.
printed_measurements are the recorder's own numbers from the header block.
Only photo_296 has the whole block inside the frame; the others are cropped
and carry the tail of it, so 'rate_bpm' truth exists for exactly one sheet.
That is a fact about the sample, not an oversight.
